steps: Buy a qualifying ENERGY STAR or ENERGY STAR Most Efficient appliance (refrigerator, washer, electric dryer, room AC, or dehumidifier).
Install it at your JCP&L service address and keep your paid receipt and account number.
Submit the official JCP&L residential appliance application within 90 days of purchase.
Your rebate is processed within 30 days after all required information is received.
